scripts/compose_smoke.sh.name: Compose quick check
scripts/compose_smoke.sh.description: Runs real Docker Compose against a built stand-in for a quick check.

scripts/compose_topology_test.py.name: Compose compatibility tests
scripts/compose_topology_test.py.description: Drives the stand-in with the real Docker Compose to check networks, ports and replicas.

scripts/doctor.py.name: Release self-test
scripts/doctor.py.description: Checks a release works: the program, scenario errors, the socket, Nginx, Redis and clean shutdown.

scripts/integration_test.py.name: Outside-in tests
scripts/integration_test.py.description: Checks the stand-in using only its socket and public answers.

scripts/matrix_harness_test.py.name: Matrix runner tests
scripts/matrix_harness_test.py.description: Checks how the orchestrator matrix classifies results and controls runs.

scripts/matrix_probe.py.name: Matrix test target
scripts/matrix_probe.py.description: A small program the matrix runner tests drive.

scripts/orchestrator_matrix.py.name: Orchestrator matrix
scripts/orchestrator_matrix.py.description: Runs an unchanged orchestrator against every scenario combination, each on a fresh stand-in.
